lesson.subtitle: Lesson 17 -- The Surf Club
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Renato | Lesson 17 -- The Surf Club
lesson.grammar_point: verbs of liking and disliking + -ing (love, like, enjoy, don't mind, can't stand, hate)

listenings.text: Right, everybody, quick one before we go out. We have a new member today. This is Renato. He is from Brazil and he surfs comps back home, so no pressure, mate. Welcome to the Scarborough High boardriders. We train on Tuesday and Thursday after school, and on Saturday at six in the morning if the swell is good. Nobody enjoys getting up at half past five, but everybody loves being first in the water. A few rules. We don't mind helping new people, but you have to ask. Nobody here likes waiting for somebody who is late, so be on the sand by a quarter past four. And in the water we share waves. If you love dropping in on people, this is the wrong club. After training we usually hang out at the kiosk and get chips. You don't have to come, but you should. That is where you actually meet everybody. Okay. Let's go.

Hey, it's Millie. Mum said you are going to the surf club today, so here is the cheat sheet, because you are going to forget everybody's name. Kai is the captain. He is nice, but he can't stand people being late, so don't be late. Jess is the one with the pink board. She loves talking, so if you are shy, stand next to her and you won't have to say anything. Tom and Ollie are twins and they always argue. Don't pick a side. And Harper is really quiet at first, but she is actually the best surfer there. She enjoys watching new people before she talks to them, so don't take it personally. Oh, and one more thing. Everybody hates the cold water in the morning. If you want to break the ice, complain about the water. It works every time. Good luck.

items.situation: Somebody at the club asks what you like doing when you are not surfing. Give two things you love and one thing you can't stand.
Kai asks if you mind training on Saturday at six in the morning. Answer honestly, with a reason.
You are standing next to Harper and she says nothing. Break the ice with a question about what she likes.
Now you are the captain. A new member asks what the club does after training. Tell him, and say what everybody enjoys.
Your host mum asks how the first training went. Tell her one thing you enjoyed and one thing you didn't like.
